title: How Meta designed Muse: an AI agent people actually want to talk to | Alex Cornell (Design Director)
author: Claire Vo
description: Listen now | 🎙️Alex Cornell explains how Muse serves your mom and an engineer with the same interface, and demos a SkyMall-style catalog, golf recaps, and a blog turned podcast
summary: Alex Cornell is a design director at Meta, where he leads design on Muse, Meta’s consumer AI agent. He came to the role with a long background in software product design, including time as a founder, and has spent the past year building one of the most thoughtful agent interfaces in the consumer AI space.
takeaways: He came to the role with a long background in software product design, including time as a founder, and has spent the past year building one of the most thoughtful agent interfaces in the consumer AI space.
Alex has been sharing the reasoning behind each of those design decisions publicly on Threads.
Muse ships with a custom avatar, a three-layer status display, a personalized ideas surface, and a generative feed.
